change_unit.title: Expose a clear revision request action in the verdict rail
change_unit.executive_summary: Review verdicts now surface a dedicated revision request action instead of hiding the next-step decision inside transcript prose.
change_unit.tutorial_markdown:
## What changed

The verdict rail now makes the next review action explicit. A reviewer can see whether the packet is approved, blocked, or asking for revision without decoding transcript text.

## Why it matters

This makes the inbox more scannable and keeps decision-making at the artifact layer instead of the chat layer.

## What to review

Check that revision language is consistent across the inbox card, the detail surface, and the replay panel verdict strip.
change_unit.next_prompt: Wire the revision request action into a lightweight prompt handoff so the next implementer session can start from the selected packet context.
